model_view.description: Charges, discharges or holds the battery. Use when a sale needs stored power: discharge in the window, charge or hold before. Not when 0 kW are owed, the battery shut off under 10 minutes ago, or a maker's event runs.

parameters.name: target
parameters.allowed: home-battery

parameters.name: action
parameters.allowed: charge | discharge | hold
parameters.says: discharge gives power, charge stores more, hold saves it for the sale

parameters.name: kw
parameters.allowed: Above 0 up to can_give_kw on a discharge, above 0 up to the charge limit on a charge, exactly 0 with hold. Code fills in the numbers. Never negative
parameters.says: power in kW, not stored kWh. Above 0, up to the limit shown. 0 only with hold

parameters.name: start
parameters.allowed: Local time. A time already past today means tomorrow. Code fills it from the window for a discharge in a sale step

parameters.name: end
parameters.allowed: Local time, after start. Earlier than start means the next morning. Code fills it from the window for a discharge in a sale step. A charge or hold ends by the window's start

model_view.description: Lowers or pauses car charging until the end time. Use when a sale has kW owed and car status is charging. Not when 0 kW are owed, or car status is idle, capped, giving, away or reserved.

parameters.name: target
parameters.allowed: car-charger

parameters.name: amps
parameters.allowed: 0, or 6 to 32. Code shows this home's own numbers
parameters.says: amps allowed, not kW. 0 pauses. Use the lowest offered

parameters.name: start
parameters.allowed: Local time. Code fills it from the sale window

parameters.name: end
parameters.allowed: Local time, after start. Code fills it from the sale window
parameters.says: when charging goes back to normal

model_view.description: Sends car power to the home. Use when car status is idle and kW are owed after the battery gives all it can. Not when 0 kW are owed, or car status is charging, capped, giving, away or reserved.

parameters.name: target
parameters.allowed: car

parameters.name: kw
parameters.allowed: Above 0, up to can_give_kw
parameters.says: the smaller of kW owed and can_give_kw

parameters.name: max_kwh
parameters.allowed: Above 0, up to the number code shows
parameters.says: kWh limit, not kW. Copy the number shown

parameters.name: start
parameters.allowed: Local time. Code fills it from the sale window

parameters.name: end
parameters.allowed: Local time, after start. Code fills it from the sale window

model_view.description: Changes the thermostat until the end time. Use when central air or a heat pump runs and kW are owed, or to pre-cool or pre-heat. Not when 0 kW are owed, can_give_kw is 0, or the owner just changed it.

parameters.name: target
parameters.allowed: main-thermostat

parameters.name: less_comfort_c
parameters.allowed: Plus is warmer when cooling and cooler when heating. Minus stores cool or warmth first. Code shows this home's own numbers, and only the sign that fits this step.
parameters.says: degrees C less comfortable: 0.5 to 2.8 in a sale, -0.4 to -1.4 before a sale

parameters.name: start
parameters.allowed: Local time. Code fills it

parameters.name: end
parameters.allowed: Local time, after start. Code fills it
parameters.says: when the normal setting comes back

model_view.description: Changes window air conditioners until the end time. Use when a window unit is cooling and kW are owed, or to pre-cool. Not when 0 kW are owed, that unit's can_give_kw is 0, or the owner just changed that unit.

parameters.name: target
parameters.allowed: all-room-acs | room-ac-1 | room-ac-2 | room-ac-3 | room-ac-4
parameters.says: all-room-acs if every unit is cooling, else each cooling unit by name

parameters.name: less_comfort_c
parameters.allowed: Plus is warmer. Minus pre-cools. Code rounds to the unit's step, so give the number as shown. Code shows this home's own numbers, and only the sign that fits this step.
parameters.says: degrees C less comfortable: 0.6 to 2.8 in a sale, -0.6 to -1.4 before a sale

parameters.name: start
parameters.allowed: Local time. Code fills it

parameters.name: end
parameters.allowed: Local time, after start. Code fills it
parameters.says: when the normal setting comes back

model_view.description: Stops or starts water heating. Use when a sale is on or coming: hold in it, load_up a below-normal tank before. Not when 0 kW are owed, hot water reads low for hold, or a sale is on for load_up.
